portal_hypertension.abstract: Acute mesenteric venous thrombosis (aMVT) is a rare but life-threatening form of mesenteric ischemia associated with 30-day mortality of 17-76% without timely therapy. Over the past decade, advances in endovascular technology have transformed the therapeutic landscape. This review comprehensively appraises current evidence on innovative interventional techniques in the management of aMVT, including catheter-directed thrombolysis (CDT), percutaneous mechanical thrombectomy (PMT), large-bore aspiration, transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS)-guided approaches, and combined endovascular strategies compared with systemic anticoagulation with regard to recanalization rates and compl...
